macro.text: Oil swung between gains and losses as mixed US-Iran signals clashed with midterm uncertainty
Gold held near $3,930 as Iran talks and US midterm results shaped the outlook
China's services activity growth slowed to a three-month low in October
India's rupee extended its recovery on dollar weakness and returning equity inflows
US midterm elections kept markets on edge over implications for stocks, yields and energy policy
S&P 500 risks a sharp selloff if it breaks below the 7,500 technical support level

corporate.note: Stock jumped 8% as data-center revenue nearly doubled, though OpenAI/Meta chip deals triggered a $1B charge
Shares popped as earnings pointed to booming AI server demand and a higher-quality customer base
Shares slid after revenue missed expectations in a less forgiving market for tech misses
Shares fell as a weak gross-margin outlook tied to a memory-chip supply crunch overshadowed results
CEO touted a new 'kill switch' feature to stop rogue AI agents, calling it a major market opportunity
Company reversed course after backlash over pulling search access from schools that ban AI tools
Airline raised checked-bag fees for the third time in a year as fuel costs climbed
Japan's JIC is reportedly planning to sell JSR to Mitsui Chemicals
Reliance Jio reportedly exploring tech-for-equity talks with Comcast and Charter

frontPage.watch: Watch whether AI-driven earnings strength from AMD and Super Micro can offset Apple's margin warning and keep the S&P 500 above the 7,500 technical level.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3731 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.854 + 0.973×ln(VIX) + 0.312×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
